message.eating_not_balanced: I can't eat the same thing twice!
commands.renourisheddelight.clear.multip: Cleared the food bar of %s players
commands.renourisheddelight.clear.failed: No targeted player had any active food
gamerule.renourisheddelight:playerStarti: Base max health a player has before any food bonuses are applied.
gamerule.renourisheddelight:maxConsumabl: Maximum number of foods a player can have active at the same time.
gamerule.renourisheddelight:foodDrainRat: How fast active foods tick down, as a percentage. 100 is normal, 50 is half speed, 0 stops food from draining.
gamerule.renourisheddelight:regenHealthT: Number of ticks between natural health regeneration. Nourishment makes this three times faster.
gamerule.renourisheddelight:nourishmentD: Nourishment granted for eating while full, as a percentage of the shortest active food's duration. Set to 0 to disable Nourishment.
gamerule.renourisheddelight:regenDelayAf: Number of ticks to wait after taking damage before natural health regeneration can resume.
gamerule.renourisheddelight:doReplaceLow: Whether eating a new food while every slot is full replaces the food with the least time left. When off, eating while full grants no new slot.
Whether eating a food you already have active tops it back up to full duration. Only applies once that food is at 50% or less of its remaining time.
gamerule.renourisheddelight:doSleepFoodD: Whether skipping the night by sleeping drains food, scaled by how much of the night was skipped. Applies to every player, not only the ones who slept.
gamerule.renourisheddelight:doNourishmen: Whether to give the player the Nourishment effect when full.
gamerule.renourisheddelight:doStarvation: Applies the configured starvation effects when the player goes without food.
